ToObject(obj) is called with `?`, then EnumerableOwnProperties(coerced, key+value) with `?`, then CreateArrayFromList of the result. Each step keeps its spec comment directly above its code. Errors propagate and nothing is hardcoded or special-cased. The only other change is renaming the unused `this` and `new_target` parameters to `_this` and `_new_target`, which is needed once they are no longer read.
